items.text: Jabalpur hands many people a genuinely different fork than most Indian cities: one of the country's largest concentrations of ordnance and defence-manufacturing units, running alongside a real legal-profession economy built around the Madhya Pradesh High Court's seat here rather than in the state capital.

If you are at a real decision point, the goal is getting clear before more time goes the wrong way, and building the kind of high-value skill portfolio that unlocks high income opportunities and moves you toward earlier financial freedom.
